theorem probe_nv_strategy :
    ∃ G : QuantumParallelRepetition.Game Unit Unit Unit Unit,
      Nonempty (QuantumParallelRepetition.Strategy G) := by
  have hpos : (1 : Matrix Unit Unit ℂ).PosSemidef := Matrix.PosSemidef.one
  have hposp : (1 : Matrix (Unit × Unit) (Unit × Unit) ℂ).PosSemidef := Matrix.PosSemidef.one
  have hcomp : (∑ _i : Unit, (1 : Matrix Unit Unit ℂ)) = 1 := by
    rw [Finset.univ_unique, Finset.sum_singleton]
  have htr : Matrix.trace (1 : Matrix (Unit × Unit) (Unit × Unit) ℂ) = 1 := by
    rw [Matrix.trace_one]
    simp
  have hw : (∑ _x : Unit, ∑ _y : Unit, (1 : ℝ)) = 1 := by
    rw [Finset.univ_unique, Finset.sum_singleton, Finset.univ_unique, Finset.sum_singleton]
  refine ⟨⟨fun _ _ => (1 : ℝ), fun _ _ => zero_le_one, hw, fun _ _ _ _ => true⟩, ⟨?_⟩⟩
  exact
    { Alice := Unit
      Bob := Unit
      state := ⟨(1 : Matrix (Unit × Unit) (Unit × Unit) ℂ), hposp, htr⟩
      aliceMeasurement := fun _ => ⟨fun _ => (1 : Matrix Unit Unit ℂ), fun _ => hpos, hcomp⟩
      bobMeasurement := fun _ => ⟨fun _ => (1 : Matrix Unit Unit ℂ), fun _ => hpos, hcomp⟩ }
